$comment: Hand-written and hand-reviewed. NOTE the two spellings: the GitHub login is `KnlCE` with a lowercase L as its third character, while the name shown to people is `KNICE` with a capital i. They are different strings that look alike, which is exactly why display_name is reviewed here rather than read off a GitHub profile — a profile name can be changed by its owner at any time, and what Astra shows must not move with it.
